china-1912:p0229_1.rationale: Table lists railway loans by year, principal, interest, issue price, redemption terms and outstanding balances, largely from foreign lenders. Loans for railways make it a finance table with a railway link.

china-1912:p0231_1.rationale: Numbered list of road routes between places, with only incidental distances in brackets. It is essentially a textual route list. The vocabulary has no tag for road routes, since roads-and-bridges covers infrastructure measures such as mileage and works.
review_questions: Should a tag for road routes or highways be added?

china-1912:p0233_1.rationale: Chief railway bridges with river, railway, length, spans and cost. These are quantitative bridge measurements for railway lines. roads-and-bridges excludes bridges tabulated only as railway assets, so only railways is supported.
review_questions: Should a tag for bridges or railway bridges be added?

china-1912:p0238_1.rationale: Annual postal statistics for 1906-1910 covering offices, agencies, articles, parcels, registered mail and money orders. These are postal operations.

china-1912:p0238_2.rationale: Postal establishments, articles and parcels by area for 1908-1910, which are statistics of postal services.

china-1912:p0239_1.rationale: Postal line lengths by mode (courier, native boat, steamer, railway) with before and after figures. These are postal network measures.

china-1912:p0240_1.rationale: New postal courier lines in Sinkiang with distances and running times, a measure of postal network and service speed.

china-1912:p0250_1.rationale: Descriptive list of the postal organisation by province, naming head and sub-head offices. The content is textual with no quantities.

china-1912:p0252_1.rationale: Textual list of four cable companies operating in China. Cable telegraphy is the subject.

china-1912:p0252_2.rationale: Statistics for 1910 of the Imperial Chinese Telegraph Administration: line and cable lengths, offices, instruments, staff, telegrams, receipts and expenditure.
